resources.string: The overlay is used during Pomodoro sessions. This permission also lets Rin open when a message arrives while you are on the home screen.
What do I have scheduled for today?
Could not complete the action. Try again.

Account created. Enter the code sent to your email.
Sign in again to use the assistant.
Rin needs display over other apps permission so she can appear above the current app later in the MVP. You can return here after changing the Android setting.
Identifies the home screen and other apps: Rin opens on the home screen and only sends notifications while you use another app. Also detects distractions during Pomodoro sessions.
Hey, I need to talk to you. Tap to open.
Usage Access settings could not be opened on this device.
Grant overlay permission before starting Rin.
Overlay settings could not be opened on this device.
You still have %1$s. Get back to what you were doing.
Again? %1$s left. Take a breath and get back to it.
Done. You actually stayed focused all that time. I am almost impressed.
Select a Rin state to update the active overlay.
Selected %1$s. Start the overlay to see it.
Rin state could not be updated.
Upload a CSV statement up to 4 MB with dates, descriptions and amounts. Larger statements will be split into parts for you to review and confirm individually before importing.
Example: main-bank. Use up to 80 unaccented letters, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Reuse the nickname when importing the same account.
I authorize uploading this file and processing its financial contents through the service.
Do not provide bank passwords. The original expires after 7 days and the preview after 30 days; deletion may occur later. Confirmed entries remain saved.
Analysis may take a few minutes. You can leave and resume on this screen.
The import is still waiting for the file or analysis. Check again. If uploading failed, start a new import and select the file again.

Review dates, positive amounts in Brazilian reais, categories and types. Remove duplicates and correct or delete unrecognized rows. Transfers and credit card payments are not spending. Compare the card statement with the payment debit. Received credit or loans are not salary or recurring income.
Possible duplicate: compare with previously imported entries before keeping this row.
Check the date, type, description and category. Use a positive amount without a thousands separator (example: 1234,56).
Correct or remove invalid rows before confirming.
I have reviewed the included entries and confirm the data.
I have reviewed possible duplicates, transfers and credit card payments.
Confirmation started and may have saved some entries. Resume with the same reviewed rows to finish without creating duplicates.
The confirmation result could not be verified yet. Check progress before changing entries.

Entries confirmed. If the CSV was split, import the remaining parts too. To check how much you can spend, review your current balance, next income, commitments, debts and reserves with Rin. The statement does not update your balance automatically.
This CSV could not be processed safely. Export the statement from your bank again and try a shorter period.
Unconfirmed changes will be discarded. The remaining parts of this file will not be imported. Confirmed entries remain saved; ongoing analysis may continue on the service.
Unconfirmed changes will be lost when you leave. You can open the original preview again. Leave now?
The file exceeds the 4 MB limit (4,000,000 bytes).
Could not read this file. Select a valid, nonempty CSV.
The CSV is incomplete or has rows with different column counts. Export the statement from your bank again.
The CSV columns were not recognized. Export a statement with a date, description and amount for each entry.
Some CSV amounts could not be interpreted safely. Check the amounts and income/expense indicators, or export the statement again.
The CSV contains invalid or unrecognized dates. Use DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD and export the statement again.
Could not read the CSV encoding. Save a UTF-8 copy and select the file again.
The CSV contains an unsupported currency. Select a statement with amounts in Brazilian reais (BRL).
The CSV exceeds the entry limit for this import. Export a shorter period.
The CSV contains %1$d entries and was split into %2$d smaller parts for analysis. Review and confirm each part before continuing to the next.
When returning to this screen, select the same CSV and choose the part that still needs importing.
Analysis could not extract the entire document. No entries from this part were confirmed. Try a smaller section; do not resubmit confirmed parts without reviewing possible duplicates.
The service rejected the data. Check the file, account nickname and entries.
The backend connection is not configured in this app yet.
Could not authenticate this operation. Try again or sign in.
Importing is currently unavailable on the service.
The import service is unavailable through this connection. Try again after the service is enabled.
The financial service is unavailable for this assistant.
Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
The service took too long to respond. Check progress before resubmitting.
The import changed or an entry conflicts. Its state was refreshed; review the current preview or resume confirmation.
The import was not found or its preview expired. Start a new import.
Uploading did not finish. Check progress or start a new import to obtain another upload authorization.
Could not complete the operation. Try again or check progress.
